assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One modular transparent scenery sprite for Depths, a dark first-person cave crawler. The reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing cave timber/fungus props. Match restrained rough painted PIXEL CLUSTERS and 3-4 shades per material, muted umber/olive/slate/bone palette, simplified to native128x128 and at most64 colours. Orthographic FRONT VIEW unless specified. Entire isolated piece inside a square canvas with small clear margins, genuine transparent alpha outside and in all gaps. Neutral diffuse albedo shading, no scene lighting, glow, ground shadow, wall background, floor rectangle, UI, text, border, checkerboard or photographic noise. This is fixed old SCENERY, never a usable container or loot. Subject: a shallow CEILING FRINGE of old moss, five irregular tapered dusty olive-green hanging strips and short rootlets, joined by a narrow dark fibrous mat across the top. Thickest mass on left, broad transparent gaps and a long clear lower half; max hanging depth about0.45m over a2m walkway. Uneven serrated clumps but no hairline fern details, flowers or bright spores. No wood beam, stone ceiling or actual wall. Moss is neutral unlit; its optional faint emission will be a separate layer.
